Class Parameter

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.processing.source.Parameter
public final class Parameter extends Object
A parameter of a method or constructor, or a component of a record, such as final String name. A receiver parameter, named this or Outer.this, gives a place to the type annotations of the receiver, as in void close(@Owned Resource this).

Parameters are values: two parameters with the same type, name, modifiers, annotations and Javadoc are equal.

      public static Parameter of(TypeName type, String name, Modifier... modifiers)
      Returns a parameter.
      Parameters:
      type - the type
      name - the name
      modifiers - the modifiers: none, or final
      Returns:
      the parameter
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is not a valid identifier, the type is void or a wildcard, or a modifier is not final, is repeated, or is given to a receiver parameter

    • of

      public static Parameter of(Type type, String name, Modifier... modifiers)
      Returns a parameter.
      Parameters:
      type - the type: a class, or a generic type
      name - the name
      modifiers - the modifiers: none, or final
      Returns:
      the parameter
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the type is void, or names a local or anonymous class, as TypeName.of(java.lang.reflect.Type) names it; the name is not a valid identifier; or a modifier is not final, is repeated, or is given to a receiver parameter

    • of

      public static Parameter of(VariableElement parameter)
      Returns a copy of a parameter found in the source: its type, with type annotations such as @Nullable, its name, and final if it has it. Declaration annotations are not copied.
      Parameters:
      parameter - the parameter
      Returns:
      the copy
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the element is not a parameter, such as a field or a local variable, or its type has no name, as TypeName.of(javax.lang.model.type.TypeMirror) names it
